metaTitle: Custom Flame Resistant Pants & Shorts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom flame resistant pants & shorts for your team. Perfect for industrial safety. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Flame resistant pants and shorts are essential for workers in welding, electrical, oil and gas, and other high-heat environments. Unlike standard workwear, these garments are made from inherently FR fabrics or treated cotton that self-extinguish when exposed to flames. Choose from multiple pocket configurations, reinforced seams, and high-visibility options. Decorate with your company logo using heat-sealed labels or screen-printed patches that maintain FR integrity. Perfect for safety managers equipping crews with durable, compliant apparel that also promotes your brand.
heroAltText: Custom flame resistant pants and shorts on a worker, featuring FR fabric and logo decoration for safety and branding.
